capability.title: Generate Long-form Copy
capability.summary: Blog posts, articles, case studies, PDP copy, email sequences, one-pagers. Structure comes from the brief and the vertical profile, never from a hard-coded template inside the workflow.

shard_seeds.description: Self-contained ideas from this piece, each strong enough to become a standalone short post. This is what makes one long-form run feed an entire channel mix.

with.system: Fix ONLY the listed violations. Preserve the angle, the structure and every sourced claim. Change the minimum number of words required.
